status_note: Frozen by the commit that first adds this file at this path. No data existed when it was written. Runner: a separate session, run.sh only.
question: Does accepting (1^4,2), (1^2,2^2) and (2^3) descent solutions whose quadratic classes are in D_exact (graph anchors at the kernel checkpoint) raise the measured descent success rate by at least 1.5x the measured full-split rate, on fresh public p1009 targets?

claims.text: rho = M/F pooled over the measured fresh targets, with its 95% envelope interval; verdict PROMOTE / KILL / INCONCLUSIVE / INVALID per decision_rule.
Every counted row satisfies the group identity, anchor identity, kernel projection and elliptic replay [d]G = Q.

hypotheses.kill_line_origin: registered in ../scout-graph-ic/LEADS.md L1 step 3 before any data; unchanged

family.curve: jv_cover weak cover y^2 = x(x-alpha)(x-sigma alpha) over F_{q^3}, q = p^2

nonce_scheme.command: fresh-scaling-gen nonce --protocol-sha256 H --commit C --drand-round R --drand-randomness X
nonce_scheme.H: sha256 of protocol.json at the freeze commit
nonce_scheme.C: first commit adding protocol.json at study_dir
nonce_scheme.R: first drand mainnet default-chain round (chain 8990e7a9aaed2ffed73dbd7092123d6f289930540d7651336225dc172e51b2ce, genesis 1595431050, period 30) with time >= committer time of C + 3600 s
nonce_scheme.X: round randomness from api.drand.sh / api2.drand.sh / drand.cloudflare.com (round number checked)
nonce_scheme.fallback: R = 0, X = tree id of C; disclosed as grindable; recorded as drand_source=fallback:freeze-tree

targets.candidates: indices 0.. in order, generated in batches (T+16, then +16), cap 160
admission: check_unseen.py: not equal to and no shared (p, alpha) with any git-tracked *public*.json, both dry-run tarballs, or an earlier candidate
pipeline public transfer spec_from_curve succeeds (runner exit 10 = refused)
targets.measured_set: first T admitted indices; collection-not-rank-ready (exit 11) counts toward T and contributes no rows

arms.definition: an arm A row or an L1 row (conditions of ../l1-steps-2-3/partial_match.rs plus group and anchor identities), replay-verified
independent stream seed, same collection, first 24 targets

pairing: both arms counted on the same residuals, Weil systems and F_p-solutions of one stream per target

instrument.binary: l1_paired (l1_paired.rs) over the 11c9a031 deferred-pair modules and the Root41-equivalent fcda1e22 closure, assembled by ../l1-steps-2-3/build

positive.pass: compare_pc1.py: every Run50 / run50-control.json pipeline number, D_exact sha256 d72462239991e6214c3e3f39fa07fdcac5bddc764f9a5bfa24410203b5fe6480, rows file sha256 61ced7abac794a742722fe21409d52c9ccbeaf39ff9e8045669b9c4dc9d87cde, both tallies; F = 31 and M = 57 (47 + 10 + 0) all replayed; 57/57 flips refused
pipeline scalar = owner answer; every replayed candidate = owner answer; replay_fail_M = 0; all flips refused

negative.what: every L1 row replayed with its first class's sign flipped
negative.pass: all flipped rows refused by the elliptic replay

a_a.pass: 99% intervals contain 1 for F_aa/F_p (conditional CP), M_aa/M_p (conditional CP), rho_aa/rho_p (log-Wald z 2.5758)

determinism.pass: first measured target run twice; target.tsv, dexact.jsonl, rows.primary.jsonl, accepted.primary.jsonl byte-identical

replay_checks_per_row: group identity (verify_dec / R + sum P + sum D = 0)
anchor witness integer incidence and anchor identity sum small_i B_i + D_key = 0
affine row: target coefficient l - b, RHS a; L1 substitution c_i = e_i + sum_j coef_j small_{j,i}
kernel projection Quotient::project of the pipeline's certified quotient; pipeline projected rows reproduced
CountedRelationSystem two-column solve with partner; elliptic replay [d]G = Q
affine consistency with the pipeline's verified (kappa*, d*) (recorded)

variable_ledger.stopping: fixed T, N; budget stop reads CPU only

blinding.note: counts are produced by the runner and read only by the frozen analysis program; no adaptive inspection

primary.definition: sum M / sum F over measured targets (replay-verified rows)
primary.interval: outer envelope of Clopper-Pearson conditional binomial (M | M+F) and target-cluster percentile bootstrap B=20000, both 95%

secondary: restricted mean residuals to first/second success per arm (censored at N)
class match rate f and random-sextic rho model
expected vs observed M by pattern given per-target f

order: INVALID if any validity gate fails
INCONCLUSIVE (underpowered) if F < 100 or F + M < 100
PROMOTE if L >= 1.5 (tier clears-2.0-line if L >= 2.0)
decision_rule.wording: KILL refuses L1 as registered (>= 1.5x); the measured 1 + rho is always reported

stopping_rules: budget: before each target stop if spent + 1.5 x max target CPU > 8 h - 600 s; analyze completed targets with budget_truncated=1
PC1/PC2/DC failure: stop, no verdict, amendment required
no stop on F, M or rho
invalidation_rules: any change to a file in SOURCES.sha256 after the freeze without a prior amendment
a re-run under the same nonce after any data were seen, except the DC rerun
targets not derived from the frozen nonce scheme
inadmissible: model full-split rate n/720 as the decision denominator
combined descent-saving or cost figures (critic F6)
any timing claim from wall fields

recording.scratch: $S: per-target pipeline summaries, dexact/rows/accepted jsonl.gz, logs; SHA-256 in $S/RAW.sha256
recording.committed: run.sh stages $S/commit/ (targets.tsv, aa.tsv, analysis.json, controls.kv, pc1.json, refused.tsv, publics.jsonl, nonce.txt, freeze.txt, cpu.tsv, build.log, RAW.sha256, COMMIT.sha256); each <= 64 KiB, larger split into .partNN

knowledge_base: research-kb and ecdb not queried; no literature, novelty or curve-database claim is made.

freeze.protocol_sha256: computed by run.sh from the freeze commit
